name: ANSI/IEEE compound-excited DC generator symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented library form of a DC generator with both series and shunt field windings, for drawing lookup.
description: A compound-excited DC generator combines a shunt field across the armature with a series field carrying load current. Depending on whether the series field aids or opposes the shunt field, terminal voltage can stay nearly flat, rise or fall with load. Such machines survive in legacy battery charging, traction and test installations.

IEEE-style schematics draw the armature circle with brushes, the series field as a winding in the armature lead and the shunt field as a separate winding across the terminals. This entry is a convention-specific lookup based on a publisher's IEEE-labelled preview; the geometry here is independently drawn and is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Identify whether the shunt field is connected across the armature only (short shunt) or across the series field as well (long shunt).
The vendor block identifier is a library name, not a standard number.
drawingChecklist: State field connection: short or long shunt, cumulative or differential.
distinction: A compound generator has both series and shunt fields; a plain DC generator symbol does not specify the field arrangement.
